versions.changelog:
- Major simplification and clarification of usage, focusing on the core manual deployment workflow.
- Consolidated and streamlined operating instructions; removed detailed implementation perimeter and extraneous rules.
- Updated installation instructions for the controller script, including guidance for legacy paths and explicit handle for mismatched versions.
- All command mappings and deployment actions are now summarized with direct, clear explanations.
- Emphasized fast, manual CI usage and made success/failure reporting requirements explicit.

Initial release of dcc-docker-container-control-skill.

- Enables discovery and control of Docker Compose deployments stored under /opt on target servers.
- Provides commands: list, status, dry-run, deploy, restart, and recreate for named Docker Compose apps.
- Requires SSH access and verifies/install the docker-container-control script on the server if needed.
- Ensures safety by confirming actions, preserving command output, and handling ambiguous or missing deployment names through user prompts.
- Only performs write actions (deploy/restart/recreate) upon explicit user request; defaults to read-only where possible.
- Monitors deployment health status and reports results clearly, including failure cases.
